messages:
Ava: Quick proposal — run a small 'Ignite Kickstart' pilot tied to the public workshop. Give 50 starter tokens + a 3-item promptpack to new users who register and attend. Primary KPI: 7-day activation (>=5 API calls OR complete 1 chat scenario).

Ravi: Agree. Recommend 3 arms for clean attribution: control / email-only / email + in-app overlay + auto-insert promptpack.

Priya: Routing notes — for signed-in RSVPers show banner + overlay post-attend. For new emails send a claim link in confirmation that redeems on a minimal landing page which preloads the promptpack.

Sam (growth): I'll randomize at RSVP and create cohorts in Amplitude. Need event schema and UTMs for attribution. Recommend randomize assignment stored as user_prop at registration.

Ava: Arms: A baseline, B email-only (confirmation + 1 follow-up with claim CTA), C email + in-app overlay (overlay shows 3 example prompts + Run one now CTA). Gift TTL = 14 days post-workshop.

Ravi: Email subject guidance: avoid the word "free". Options: "Your Redwood kickstart toolkit" or "Kickstart: templates + starter tokens". Keep preheader 45 chars.

Priya: I'll draft 2 email variants (short/demo) and 2 banner lengths. Email will include 1 sample prompt inline to show value.

Sam (growth): Event list I'll track:
- workshop_registered
- workshop_attended
- kickstart_claimed (prop: arm, code)
- first_api_call (prop: success)
- prompt_template_used (prop: template_id)
- overlay_shown
- overlay_action (run_now/copy)
- tour_started
- tour_completed
Also properties: user_cohort (A/B/C), signup_source, utm_campaign, utm_variant.

prod-bot: Ops note — promo tokens single-use, TTL 14d. Use POST /promo/generate with marketing-scoped key. Landing path: /kickstart/claim/<code>. Landing fires kickstart_claimed then redirects to /quickstart?preload=promptpack_id.

Ava: Can overlay be lightweight: 3 cards + one-click run that triggers first_api_call? Track run_immediate. Also test CTA copy: Run vs Explore.

Ravi: Agree. Add tiny A/B inside arm C for CTA copy; low-friction and insightful.

Sam (growth): I'll add sample-size calc. Tentative targets: arm C claim rate 18-25%, arm B 7-11%, baseline 2-4%. Target +8-12pp 7-day activation lift vs control. Will post formal numbers by EOD Friday.

Priya: Uploading copy to marketing drive Wed 10am PT, tagging legal for token terms.

Ava: Quick checklist: [ ] Amplitude spec & cohorts (Sam) [ ] Promo generation & scoped key (prod-bot) [ ] Claim landing + analytics (prod-bot) [ ] Email/banner/overlay copy (Priya) [ ] Promptpack + 3 exemplar prompts (Ava) [ ] Legal sign-off (Priya/Legal) [ ] QA plan (Ravi).

Ravi: I'll QA assets Thu, Sam ping me when cohorts are live for attribution sanity-check.

Sam (growth): Will post sample sizes and include UTM matrix (utm_medium=workshop, utm_campaign=ignite_kickstart, utm_variant=A/B/C).

Ava: If no objections, lock arms tomorrow and schedule a 20m sync after Priya posts drafts.

Priya: Sounds good — posting Wed 10am PT.

Ravi: :thumbsup:
